external_narratives.summary: Detailed crash investigation page for Hampden X3154 of No. 106 Squadron RAF, which crashed into the southern side of Rushup Edge on 21 December 1940 during a night navigation exercise from RAF Finningley. The aircraft was 50 miles off track at the time of impact.
key_details: Inquiry found pilot and navigator responsible

narrative: The aircraft struck the southern side of Rushup Edge in the Peak District, likely due to the hazardous conditions of low-level night flying in this terrain. All three men aboard were killed: Pilot Officer Michael Hubbard, aged 20, Sergeant Kenneth Walsingham Boyd Perkins, aged 24, and Sergeant David William Smith, aged just 19. There were no survivors.
